tables.name: historical_objective_proposals
columns: task_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES wfm_task_identities(task_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
expected_matching_operational_plan_revision_id TEXT NULL REFERENCES task_plan_revisions(plan_revision_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('pending','accepted','rejected','superseded'))
last_command_id TEXT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
rules: eligible for provider Complete with exact valid accepted source plan and current unassigned WFM even when no operational plan yet exists

if a current operational plan exists it must exactly match the source interval to remain directly acceptable; a differing plan requires separate plan reconciliation and supersedes/stales this proposal
acceptance may create origin=historical_source_structure plan revision only when no current operational plan exists
acceptance creates structure only and never inserts execution/outcome/Inventory evidence

required_indexes: all command/FK columns receive LLD-01 leading-prefix FK coverage
